how_to_apply: Download the application form from the Recruitment section of the Krishnagiri district website, krishnagiri.nic.in.
Fill the form completely and affix a recent photograph.
Attach self-attested copies of all required certificates (see Important Instructions below); applications without these will be rejected.
Submit the completed application either in person or by Speed Post to the address given below.
Ensure the application reaches the office on or before 22 September 2026, 5:00 PM. Original documents and experience certificates must be produced at the time of interview.
important_instructions: These posts are purely temporary and will not be made permanent at any time. Applications are accepted only in person or by Speed Post - no online or email applications are mentioned in the notification. The following certificate copies must be compulsorily attached with the application: (1) 10th class mark certificate, (2) 12th class mark certificate, (3) Degree/Diploma certificate and registration certificate, (4) Degree/Diploma mark certificates, (5) Community/Caste certificate, (6) Previous experience certificate approved by a competent authority, and (7) Priority/special certificates, if any. Applications without the above certificate copies will be rejected. The Dentist post will be filled on a rotation basis. The number of vacant posts is subject to change. Full details of the posts are available on the Krishnagiri district website, krishnagiri.nic.in.

faq.question: Q1. What is Krishnagiri DHS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification by the District Health Society, Krishnagiri, to fill 69 contractual posts across 25 categories in Government health facilities in Krishnagiri district, Tamil Nadu.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Krishnagiri DHS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: 69 vacancies, with the largest numbers in Lab Technician Gr-2 (19) and Health Inspector Gr-II (19).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for Krishnagiri DHS Recruitment 2026?
Q4. What is the qualification required for Krishnagiri DHS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Qualification varies widely by post, from 8th class pass with Tamil literacy (Cleaner, Lab Assistant) to MBBS (Medical Officer) or BDS (Dentist) - see the post-wise qualification table above.

faq.question: Q5. Is there an online application for Krishnagiri DHS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No. Applications are accepted only in person or by Speed Post; there is no online application mode mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for Krishnagiri DHS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By downloading the application form from krishnagiri.nic.in, attaching the required certificate copies, and submitting it in person or by Speed Post to the District Health Society office, Krishnagiri, before the last date.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for Krishnagiri DHS posts?
faq.answer: It ranges from Rs. 11,000 per month (Multipurpose Hospital Worker, CEmONC Security, Cleaner, Lab Assistant) to Rs. 60,000 per month (Medical Officer), varying by post.
